content.comment_body: Hello! Is there a way to use the OK and ESC buttons in [product_name] in the same way as the cursor buttons? If so, how can this be done? Thanks in advance for any suggestions. Previous threads have been very helpful, so thank you.
Hi, It's not possible to use the ESC and OK buttons as programmable inputs in your application.
Thanks for the quick response. I solved the issue by using a combination of two button presses.

analysis.insight_summary: The central issue is the restriction of not being able to use OK and ESC buttons as programmable inputs in [product_name], unlike cursor keys, which limits software customization and user control. Users must rely on alternative methods or workarounds to achieve desired functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping to assign custom functions to the OK and ESC buttons within [product_name], similar to what is possible with cursor buttons.
